llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed third-party image generation wrapper that uses dLazy's hosted API and does not show hidden or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: Network use to api.dlazy.com and files.dlazy.com, prompt submission, and upload of user-specified local media files are proportionate to a cloud image-generation service and are described in the skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The install path uses npm or npx for a pinned @dlazy/cli version, with source, npm package, and homepage metadata provided.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger phrases include generic image-generation terms, so users should be aware it may be selected for broad image requests, but the external API behavior is disclosed.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The CLI can persist an API key in ~/.dlazy/config.json and optionally be installed globally; both behaviors are disclosed, and key rotation or revocation is described.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Nano Banana 2.0 text-to-image and image-to-image generation, and the documented capabilities match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only if you are comfortable using dLazy as an external cloud image service. Prompts and any local media paths you pass can be uploaded to dLazy, and login may store an API key locally.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad English trigger terms are real, but they align with an image-generation skill; the main user consideration is avoiding unintended use of the third-party SaaS for sensitive prompts or images.
[SQP-1] expected: The Chinese trigger terms similarly broaden selection, but the skill clearly describes that prompts and selected files are sent to dLazy endpoints.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese file is a localized companion to the English skill rather than hidden language switching; this does not create an independent security concern.
